query:
SELECT 
  e.nome as unidade,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as total_profissionais,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.categoria) as categorias
FROM empresas e
LEFT JOIN profissionais p ON p.empresaId = e.id AND p.ativo = 1
GROUP BY e.id, e.nome
ORDER BY e.nome;
